title: Late Vehicle Registration Renewals and Registration Grace: Worked Cases
content:
This case set applies a rule of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product. A Wayfare driver's past late vehicle registration renewals, shown by second expiry notices for the registration, shorten the registration grace days: the calendar days after a lapsed vehicle registration's expiry date on which the document hold for it begins.

## Rule

When the standing record holds three or more second expiry notices for the vehicle registration dated fewer than 36 whole calendar months before the day the grace is worked out, the registration grace days change by -2 days; when it holds one or two, they change by -1 day; when it holds none, they do not change.

| Second expiry notices for the vehicle registration, dated fewer than 36 whole calendar months back | Change to the registration grace days |
|---|---|
| three or more | -2 |
| one or two | -1 |
| none | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical, grace worked out on 2026-06-01)

**Case 1.** Second notices for the registration dated 2023-12-03, 2024-11-28 and 2025-11-29: all fewer than 36 whole calendar months back. Three notices, change -2.

**Case 2.** Second notices for the registration dated 2023-05-20 and 2025-11-29. The first is more than 36 whole calendar months back. One notice counts, change -1.

**Case 3.** First notices for the registration only, and second notices for the auto insurance. None of these is a second notice for the vehicle registration: no change.
